newsitem.title: USA: Central Park mother charged with abandonment.
newsitem.headline: Central Park mother charged with abandonment.

text.p: A young mother who left her toddler and infant in Central Park while she went to buy ice cream and never returned was charged Wednesday with abandonment and endangering the welfare of her children, prosecutors said.

The woman, Lori Ann Williamston, 33, faces up to four years in prison on the two counts of abandoning her two children, Lacey, 8 months old and Kiyah, 3. She also faces up to one year in prison on the two counts of endangerment.
Williamston admitted to detectives who traced the woman to her apartment that she left them alone at a park playground without arranging for their care and did not return to pick them up.
She also told detectives that she left her children for more than nine hours and "intended to give up her children by leaving them in the park."
The two girls were left in the park in a stroller that contained baby formula, cereal, clothing and toys.

The mother had asked a nanny who was looking after another child in the playground to watch the girls while she went to buy ice cream. The nanny called police when the woman failed to return after almost an hour.
